assembly: Only actual new imagegen upgrade paint is exported. Fixed uniform camera per painted viewport; explicit atlas gutter/contact registration. No limb warp, per-pose resizing, source recolor, transformed idle or reused base frame. DEAD exactly matches final DEATH. Joined failed components are excluded whole and replaced by new genuine paintings.

credits.author: OpenAI built-in image_gen; project-directed independent upgrade paintings and technical extraction
